howto.what: Claude在视频处理时会先检查编码器，测试短片段，若编码失败则依次尝试libx264、mpeg4、复制模式，最后用moviepy的捆绑ffmpeg。
howto.when: 当用户要求处理视频文件，或ffmpeg编码报错时，Claude会启用渐进降级策略。

say.text: 转码这个视频，如果libx264失败就用mpeg4。
把这两个视频合并，用moviepy处理。
say.note: Claude使用moviepy绕过系统编码问题。

say.text: 处理这个视频，优先用copy模式保持画质。

howto.what_en: When processing videos, Claude first checks available encoders, tests a short clip with the preferred codec (libx264), and if it fails, falls back to mpeg4, then copy mode, and finally uses moviepy's bundled ffmpeg as a safety net.
howto.when_en: This skill is triggered when the user requests video processing, especially when ffmpeg encoding errors occur, such as when running in containers or with unknown codecs.

say_en.text: Transcode this video, fallback to mpeg4 if libx264 fails.

say_en.note: Claude uses moviepy to avoid system issues.

say_en.text: Process this video, prefer copy mode.
say_en.note: Claude tries no-reencode copy mode first.
